notes.title: The game is released as Early Access!
notes.notes:
Today we are proud to release Planet Guardian VR (Early Access)

A casual action game for the HTC Vive designed for room-scale only, where you protect planets from asteroids.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31324051/6c1b65ee2a5606d80f35f20778c86381f3c9548c.jpg[/img]

Early Access will allow us to fine-tune the game with valuable user feedback. We have a few gameplay feature ideas, but would also love to hear what YOU like (or not) about the game, and what you wish to see in the future.
